name: Epilogue shared-memory load iterator
summary: Reload exchanged accumulator tiles from shared memory into thread fragments arranged for output operations.

strategy.intent: Construct a legal and performance-relevant GEMM tile mapping for the target architecture.
strategy.mechanism: Map output thread lanes to shared-memory rows and vector loads after accumulator exchange.
strategy.expected_benefit: Exposes data reuse and parallel Tensor Core work while respecting layout and resource limits.
tradeoffs: Tile choices change shared-memory use, register pressure, occupancy, and available grid parallelism.

parameters.description: Tunable or derived tile property: thread_map.

parameters.description: Tunable or derived tile property: elements_per_access.

constraints.expression: shared load mapping matches accumulator store mapping
constraints.rationale: Reloaded fragments must preserve output coordinates.
